vt-county-officials.summary: The County card says the county has no county board, and names none of its sheriff, state's attorney, probate judge or assistant judges.
vt-county-officials.why: No statewide list of Vermont's county officials has been read for this app yet, and the counties' own pages have not been read one by one.
vt-county-officials.wanted: A list of each county's sheriff, state's attorney, probate judge and assistant judges, from the state or from the county itself.

vt-municipal-officeholders.summary: The Town or City card names the town or city you picked, and not its select board, mayor or council.
vt-municipal-officeholders.why: No statewide list of the elected officials of Vermont's towns and cities has been read for this app, and their own pages have not been read one by one.
vt-municipal-officeholders.wanted: One statewide list of each town or city's select board, mayor or council, or a town or city's own published list of them.

vt-school-board-members.summary: The School District card names the district you picked, and not the members of its school board.
vt-school-board-members.why: No list of the members of Vermont's school boards has been read for this app, and the districts' own pages have not been read one by one.
vt-school-board-members.wanted: One statewide list of each school district's board members, or a district's own published list of its board.
